data_fields.name: action_slots
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (only the middle slot takes an action)

best_idea: Select on the first tap and engage on a second tap of the same target (the second tap replaces the queued action and uses a fixed range), with the target frame stacked under the target's projected anchor and dropped when the target is no longer valid.
decision_why: Keep the two-tap select-then-engage (fits engage as a state change; the server still verifies the kill) and the anchored stack; drop the hover reticle on phones (no cursor); fix the reticle flags the donor gets wrong.
acceptance: A player taps an enemy once and sees its frame (name, red health, one action slot) under it; a second tap sends one engage with range from data; the frame clears in the next frame after the enemy dies or leaves the screen; a faction flip never leaves a stray hover reticle (client test).
